alt_full_audit.scope: every byte of all ZIP members; all non-video parsed; video metadata plus first/middle/last decode samples
alt_full_audit.not_done: no frame-by-frame semantic viewing of the videos; no claim that image content was manually reviewed

over_segmentation.definition: detected change points divided by annotated segments
detected change points divided by annotated segments

coverage.definition: A segment is covered when at least one detected change point lies in [start-tol, end+tol]; tol_half_segment uses tol = duration/2.

bocpd.definition: detected change points divided by annotated segments

baseline.definition: detected change points divided by annotated segments

downstream_auc.definition: Positive class = annotated segment contains at least one bad frame (n_bad > 0). Scores are oriented so that larger means 'less reliable'. hierarchical_looo removes the segment's own frames from the record counts, so it never sees its own label.

within_record.definition: Only records that contain BOTH a clean and a bad segment are usable. Record-level scores are constant inside a record, so their within-record AUC is 0.5 by construction; only the segment layer can beat that.

notes: All values are computed by code/alt_p1_bocpd.py from the released archives.
Boundary F1 uses greedy one-to-one nearest matching within the tolerance.
Segments are semantic annotations; strict-tolerance F1 is expected to be low, so coverage and length agreement are reported next to F1.
downstream_auc uses a leave-one-segment-out posterior so the reliability score never sees the label of the segment it scores.

meta.method: damped constant-velocity Kalman filter + value-of-information scheduling
meta.note: all numbers produced by code/alt_p2_kalman.py from data/panel_alt.npz; no masked truth is read by the predictor

model.fit: method of moments; alpha selected on validation (official information rule)

mask_protocol.definition: prefix=6 frames; mask L in {6,12,18,30}; clean prefix+mask; stride max(1,L/2); cap 300/test split; target = last masked frame

voi.rule: buy the next look iff posterior position-trace reduction > lambda (cm^2 per cost unit); look adds 12 prefix frames, costs 1, consumes 30 frames of lead
voi.note: marginal reductions are equal under the fitted horizon-dominated covariance, so the policy is a step function (0 or 2 looks), not an interior 1-look rule; posterior covariance is data-independent, so per-record VOI collapses to the same rule for every record

limitations: Q,R 取对角，逐坐标独立滤波；手指之间的瞬时相关被忽略，这会让指尖误差被高估或低估，具体方向取决于相关符号。
只评估主导手；非主导手只用于选择主导手，不进入误差统计。
掩蔽协议是官方协议的可见子集：prefix 固定 0.2 s，官方还允许 0.6/1.0 s 前缀；A/B/C 三选项的 lead 分别为 90/60/30 帧，与官方 p2_official.py 的动作空间一致。L 集合按任务指定 {0.2,0.4,0.6,1.0}s，官方 p2_predict.py 另用 {6,15,30,60} 帧，本模块不覆盖后者。
VOI 的 trace 来自线性高斯后验，协方差与观测值无关：所有记录、所有窗口的后验 trace 只由 alpha、q、r 和 horizon 决定，因此逐记录 VOI 退化为同一条规则，无法体现“某条记录更值得看”的样本差异。
噪声参数 q,r 弱可辨识：r 从 1e-9 量级翻倍对误差几乎无影响（见消融），真实观测噪声可能被过程噪声吸收。
未做跨被试泛化：split 沿用官方 record_split.csv（train 55 / validation 7 / test 7），测试集只有 7 条记录。
没有把误差换算成成本；VOI 阈值以 cm^2/成本单位给出，成本到厘米的换算需要赛题额外给定。

_meta.title: P3 alternative backup: scenario chance-constrained MIP + rolling horizon
_meta.protocol: corrected actual p=alpha*d+beta; C=s+p; device release=s+max(p,b); cost=2+0.1b+0.2D; admission s+b<=H and cost+c<=B
_meta.data: official tasks.csv + source_segment_index.csv; true durations resampled from the validation split with the official rng stream; seeds 2026111700..2026111729

params.residual_source: all 343 eligible segments (train+validation+test) of source_segment_index.csv, per family x prefix, 5%-95% quantile grid, ranks de-correlated per unit by crc32 so scenarios are not comonotone

edf_old.description: official p3_stochastic_schedule.py, policy edf_old (earliest due date, prediction-based reserve, paid review when it raises on-time probability)

slack_old.description: official p3_stochastic_schedule.py, policy slack_old (slack-weighted priority, adaptive reserve, pressure-triggered dropping)

ccmip_reserve.description: CC-MIP ordering by the median-scenario CP-SAT model (order only), reserve b_j solved from the chance constraint P(p_j > b_j) <= eps by empirical family x prefix quantiles, re-planned after every completion / paid observation (rolling)

ccmip_rolling.description: full joint CC-MIP: order, reserve b_j and paid observations all decided by the N-scenario CP-SAT model, re-solved after every completion / observation

ccmip_oneshot.description: same joint CC-MIP but solved once at t=0, never re-planned (ablation isolating the value of the rolling horizon)
